en.title: There Is Room to Weep
en.blessing: Shavuah Tov! May today's Aliyah help me face grief honestly and accept help with what must be done.
en.hook: Avraham wept for Sarah before he negotiated for her grave.
en.summary: Sarah dies at 127 in Hebron, and Avraham comes to mourn and weep for her. He then asks the sons of Heth for a burial possession. He requests the cave of Machpelah at its full price and weighs out the 400 shekels named by Ephron (23:1–16).

questions.q: What does Avraham do before discussing the burial?
questions.answer: He mourns Sarah and weeps for her.
key: The man who trusted יהוה still cried.
Nothing in this account treats his tears as a failure.
questions.action: Allow yourself ten quiet minutes to acknowledge a loss without explaining it away.

questions.q: What does Avraham ask for when graves are offered to him?
questions.answer: He asks to purchase a particular cave at its full price.
key: He makes the arrangement he wants clear.
The passage gives no market comparison, so I cannot claim that Ephron cheated him.
questions.action: Put the price and terms of one pending agreement in writing.

questions.q: How do I read these tears alongside Yeshua’s demand to follow Him?
questions.answer: I must take Yeshua’s urgent call seriously without inventing a prohibition on mourning.
key: Luke does not tell me whether the man’s father has already died.
I cannot use that silence to shame a bereaved person.
questions.action: Read Luke 9:59–60 beside Bereishit 23:2 before commenting on someone’s grief.

questions.q: When someone is grieving, do I make room for their pain or try to stop it?
questions.answer: I need to listen before deciding what they ought to feel.
key: A quick instruction to be strong can leave someone carrying their loss alone.
Sitting with them may be the help they need today.
questions.action: Contact one grieving person and offer to listen without giving advice.
questions.detail: Sit shiva (look it up and live it!)

questions.q: What practical help can I offer someone who is grieving?
questions.answer: I can offer to carry one specific task, with their permission.
key: Funeral arrangements, meals and paperwork arrive while people are still in shock.
A clear offer is easier to answer than a vague promise of help.
questions.action: Offer one meal, lift or administrative task, and let the person choose.

en.actionOfDay: Before tonight, offer a grieving person one specific task you can do this week; follow their wishes.

af.title: Daar Is Plek vir Trane
af.blessing: Shavuah Tov! Mag vandag se Aliyah my help om eerlik te rou en hulp te aanvaar met wat gedoen moet word.
af.hook: Avraham het oor Sarah gehuil voordat hy oor haar graf onderhandel het.
af.summary: Sarah sterf op 127 in Gevron, en Avraham kom om oor haar te rou en haar te beween. Daarna vra hy die seuns van Get vir ’n graf as eiendom. Hy vra die grot van Magpela teen die volle prys en weeg die 400 shekels af wat Efron genoem het (23:1–16).

questions.q: Wat doen Avraham voordat hy die begrafnis bespreek?
questions.answer: Hy rou oor Sarah en huil oor haar.
key: Die man wat יהוה vertrou het, het steeds gehuil.
Niks in hierdie gedeelte stel sy trane as ’n mislukking voor nie.
questions.action: Gun jouself tien stil minute om ’n verlies te erken sonder om dit weg te praat.

questions.q: Waarvoor vra Avraham toe hulle vir hom grafte aanbied?
questions.answer: Hy vra om ’n bepaalde grot teen die volle prys te koop.
key: Hy stel duidelik wat hy wil reël.
Die gedeelte vergelyk nie grondpryse nie; ek kan dus nie beweer dat Efron hom verkul het nie.
questions.action: Skryf die prys en voorwaardes van een uitstaande ooreenkoms neer.

questions.q: Hoe lees ek hierdie trane saam met Yeshua se oproep om Hom te volg?
questions.answer: Ek moet Yeshua se dringende oproep ernstig opneem sonder om ’n verbod op rou daaruit af te lei.
key: Lukas sê nie of die man se vader reeds dood was nie.
Ek kan nie daardie stilte gebruik om iemand wat rou, te beskaam nie.
questions.action: Lees Lukas 9:59–60 saam met Bereishit 23:2 voordat jy oor iemand se rou kommentaar lewer.

questions.q: Maak ek plek vir iemand se hartseer, of probeer ek dit laat ophou?
questions.answer: Ek moet luister voordat ek besluit hoe die persoon behoort te voel.
key: Om gou te sê iemand moet sterk wees, kan hulle alleen laat voel met hulle verlies.
Miskien het hulle vandag net iemand nodig wat by hulle sal sit.
questions.action: Kontak iemand wat rou en bied aan om sonder raad te luister.

questions.q: Watter praktiese hulp kan ek iemand gee wat rou?
questions.answer: Ek kan aanbied om met hulle toestemming een bepaalde taak oor te neem.
key: Begrafnisreëlings, etes en papierwerk wag nie totdat die skok verby is nie.
’n Duidelike aanbod is makliker om op te antwoord as ’n vae belofte van hulp.
questions.action: Bied een ete, rit of administratiewe taak aan en laat die persoon kies.

af.actionOfDay: Bied voor vanaand aan om hierdie week een bepaalde taak vir iemand wat rou te doen; respekteer hulle wense.

en.title: Can I Accept Their No?
en.blessing: Boker Tov! May today's Aliyah help me carry my responsibilities without taking over someone else’s choice.
en.hook: Avraham trusted יהוה with the journey and still made provision for the woman to refuse.
en.summary: The field and cave become Avraham’s purchased possession, and he buries Sarah there. Later, he commissions his senior servant to find a wife for Yitzchak among his relatives. He forbids taking Yitzchak back to his former land and releases the servant from the oath if the woman will not come (23:17–24:9).

questions.q: What happens if the woman will not come?
questions.answer: The servant is released from the oath, but he must not take Yitzchak back.
key: Avraham names a limit to the assignment.
The servant is not ordered to secure agreement at any cost.
Ensure a fair assignment!
questions.action: Write down what you are responsible for in one difficult situation and what another person must decide.

questions.q: How does Avraham hold conviction and another person’s refusal together?
questions.answer: He maintains his instruction about the land while allowing for an unsuccessful proposal.
key: He expects יהוה to guide the journey.
That expectation does not erase the possibility of refusal.
questions.action: Identify one conviction you must keep without forcing someone else’s agreement.

questions.q: What does Psalm 106 add to this concern about family influence?
questions.answer: It shows how learning destructive practices can lead a community into grave wrongdoing.
key: The psalm names idolatry and the shedding of innocent blood.
It does not give me permission to despise people because of their ancestry.
questions.action: Name one harmful practice you need to refuse rather than labelling an entire group.

questions.q: Have I used “יהוה told me” to make someone feel unable to refuse me?
questions.answer: I need to check whether my language has made room for an honest answer.
key: This matters when discussing marriage, ministry, money or a move.
My certainty does not make another person’s decision mine to control.
questions.action: Remove spiritual pressure from one request and ask for an honest answer.

questions.q: What can I do when someone’s answer disappoints me?
questions.answer: I can respect their answer and decide how to proceed within my own responsibilities.
key: Disappointment can be painful without justifying repeated pressure.
A willing answer cannot be produced by wearing someone down.
questions.action: Accept one clear refusal without reopening the argument today.

en.actionOfDay: Within 24 hours, revisit one request you have made and make clear that the other person may answer honestly, including no.

af.title: Kan Ek Hulle Nee Aanvaar?
af.blessing: Boker Tov! Mag vandag se Aliyah my help om my verantwoordelikhede na te kom sonder om iemand anders se keuse oor te neem.
af.hook: Avraham het יהוה met die reis vertrou en steeds voorsiening gemaak dat die vrou kon weier.
af.summary: Die grond en grot word Avraham se gekoopte eiendom, en hy begrawe Sarah daar. Later stuur hy sy oudste dienaar om onder sy familie ’n vrou vir Yitzchak te gaan soek. Hy verbied dat Yitzchak na sy vorige land teruggeneem word en stel die dienaar vry van die eed indien die vrou nie wil kom nie (23:17–24:9).

questions.q: Wat gebeur as die vrou nie wil saamkom nie?
questions.answer: Die dienaar is vry van die eed, maar hy mag Yitzchak nie terugneem nie.
key: Avraham stel ’n grens aan die opdrag.
Die dienaar hoef nie ten alle koste ’n ja te kry nie.
questions.action: Skryf neer waarvoor jy in een moeilike situasie verantwoordelik is en wat iemand anders moet besluit.

questions.q: Hoe hou Avraham sy oortuiging en iemand anders se moontlike weiering bymekaar?
questions.answer: Hy hou by sy opdrag oor die land en maak tog voorsiening dat die huweliksvoorstel nie aanvaar word nie.
key: Hy verwag dat יהוה die reis sal lei.
Dit beteken nie dat die vrou se moontlike weiering verdwyn nie.
questions.action: Benoem een oortuiging waarby jy moet bly sonder om iemand anders se instemming af te dwing.

questions.q: Wat voeg Psalm 106 by hierdie saak van familie-invloed?
questions.answer: Dit wys hoe die aanleer van vernietigende gebruike ’n gemeenskap tot ernstige verkeerde dade kan lei.
key: Die psalm noem afgodery en die vergieting van onskuldige bloed.
Dit gee my nie toestemming om mense oor hulle afkoms te verag nie.
questions.action: Benoem een skadelike gebruik wat jy moet afwys eerder as om ’n hele groep te veroordeel.

questions.q: Het ek al “יהוה het vir my gesê” gebruik sodat iemand nie durf nee sê nie?
questions.answer: Ek moet ondersoek of my woorde ruimte vir ’n eerlike antwoord gelaat het.
key: Dit maak saak wanneer ons oor trou, bediening, geld of verhuising praat.
My sekerheid gee my nie beheer oor iemand anders se besluit nie.
questions.action: Haal die geestelike druk uit een versoek en vra vir ’n eerlike antwoord.

questions.q: Wat kan ek doen wanneer iemand se antwoord my teleurstel?
questions.answer: Ek kan die antwoord respekteer en besluit hoe om my eie verantwoordelikhede verder na te kom.
key: Teleurstelling kan seer wees sonder dat dit aanhoudende druk regverdig.
Om iemand moeg te praat, gee my nie ’n gewillige antwoord nie.
questions.action: Aanvaar een duidelike weiering sonder om vandag weer daaroor te stry.

af.actionOfDay: Gaan binne 24 uur terug na een versoek wat jy gerig het en maak dit duidelik dat die ander persoon eerlik mag antwoord, ook nee.

en.title: Notice Who Carries the Water
en.blessing: Boker Tov! May today's Aliyah teach me to notice character in ordinary work and share the load at home.
en.hook: Rivkah’s kindness meant repeated trips to the well until the camels had finished drinking.
en.summary: The servant travels with ten camels and prays beside the well for a woman who will offer water to him and his camels. Rivkah arrives before he finishes speaking and does exactly that. He observes her, asks about her family and lodging, and bows in worship (24:10–26).

questions.q: What does Rivkah offer beyond the drink he requests?
questions.answer: She offers to draw water for his camels until they have finished drinking.
key: She notices a need and follows through.
The account describes actual work, not merely a friendly greeting.
questions.action: Finish one practical task that will ease someone else’s day.
questions.detail: Are you following through on a need you noticed?

questions.q: Why does the servant continue watching and asking questions?
questions.answer: He is still seeking to know whether יהוה has made the journey successful.
key: He does not stop observing after the first encouraging moment.
He also asks who she is and whether there is room to stay.
questions.action: Ask one necessary factual question before making a major commitment.
questions.detail: Keep observing! Do not lean on your own understanding!

questions.q: How does Psalm 106 connect praise with ordinary conduct?
questions.answer: It praises יהוה and calls those who practise justice blessed.
key: Rivkah’s helpfulness and the servant’s worship appear in the same scene.
Praise should lead me to examine how I treat people when work needs doing.
questions.action: Share one household task before settling into your own plans.

questions.q: Whose work have I stopped noticing because they always do it?
questions.answer: I need to look at who keeps carrying the repeated tasks around me.
key: Meals, cleaning, lifts and care do not happen on their own.
Thanking someone matters; taking a turn matters too.
questions.action: Ask the person carrying the routine work which task you can take over today.

questions.q: How can I practise generosity without assuming one person must always serve?
questions.answer: I can offer help myself and agree on a fair share of the work.
key: Rivkah’s voluntary offer does not entitle me to someone else’s exhaustion.
This passage first asks what I am willing to do.
questions.action: Take responsibility for one agreed task from beginning to end.

en.actionOfDay: Today, take over one routine task someone else usually carries and complete it without making them supervise you.

af.title: Sien Wie die Water Aandra
af.blessing: Boker Tov! Mag vandag se Aliyah my leer om karakter in gewone werk raak te sien en tuis my deel te doen.
af.hook: Rivkah se goedheid het beteken dat sy heen en weer na die put geloop het totdat die kamele klaar gedrink het.
af.summary: Die dienaar reis met tien kamele en bid by die put vir ’n vrou wat vir hom en sy kamele water sal aanbied. Rivkah kom voordat hy klaar gepraat het en doen presies dit. Hy hou haar dop, vra oor haar familie en slaapplek, en buig in aanbidding neer (24:10–26).

questions.q: Wat bied Rivkah aan bo en behalwe die drinkwater wat hy vra?
questions.answer: Sy bied aan om vir sy kamele te skep totdat hulle genoeg gedrink het.
key: Sy sien die behoefte raak en doen die werk klaar.
Die verhaal beskryf werklike inspanning, nie net ’n vriendelike groet nie.
questions.action: Maak een praktiese taak klaar wat iemand anders se dag sal vergemaklik.

questions.q: Waarom hou die dienaar aan om waar te neem en vrae te vra?
questions.answer: Hy probeer steeds vasstel of יהוה sy reis voorspoedig gemaak het.
key: Hy hou nie ná die eerste bemoedigende oomblik op om op te let nie.
Hy vra ook wie sy is en of daar plek is om oor te bly.
questions.action: Vra een nodige feitevraag voordat jy ’n groot verbintenis aangaan.

questions.q: Hoe verbind Psalm 106 lof met ons gewone optrede?
questions.answer: Dit loof יהוה en noem dié wat geregtigheid doen geseënd.
key: Rivkah se hulpvaardigheid en die dienaar se aanbidding staan in dieselfde toneel.
Lof behoort my te laat kyk hoe ek mense behandel wanneer daar werk is.
questions.action: Doen jou deel van ’n huistaak voordat jy met jou eie planne aangaan.

questions.q: Wie se werk sien ek nie meer raak nie omdat hulle dit altyd doen?
questions.answer: Ek moet kyk wie om my die herhalende take bly dra.
key: Etes, skoonmaak, vervoer en versorging gebeur nie vanself nie.
Dankie sê maak saak; om jou beurt te neem ook.
questions.action: Vra die persoon wat die daaglikse werk dra watter taak jy vandag kan oorneem.

questions.q: Hoe kan ek vrygewig wees sonder om te aanvaar dat een persoon altyd moet dien?
questions.answer: Ek kan self hulp aanbied en saam besluit hoe om die werk billik te verdeel.
key: Rivkah se vrywillige aanbod gee my nie aanspraak op iemand anders se uitputting nie.
Hierdie gedeelte vra eers wat ek bereid is om te doen.
questions.action: Neem een afgespreekte taak van begin tot einde op jou.

af.actionOfDay: Neem vandag een roetinetaak oor wat iemand anders gewoonlik doen en handel dit af sonder dat hulle jou deur elke stap hoef te lei.

en.title: Say What You Came to Say
en.blessing: Boker Tov! May today's Aliyah help me speak truthfully and finish the responsibility entrusted to me.
en.hook: Avraham’s servant asked for a clear answer after explaining why he had come.
en.summary: The servant blesses יהוה for His loyalty and guidance. At Rivkah’s home, he insists on explaining his business before eating and recounts his commission, prayer and encounter at the well. He asks the family for a definite answer; when Lavan and Bethuel agree, he bows to יהוה (24:27–52).

questions.q: What does the servant insist on doing before eating?
questions.answer: He insists on explaining the business that brought him there.
key: He enjoys hospitality without forgetting his assignment.
He identifies whose servant he is and why he has come.
questions.action: State the purpose of one necessary conversation in its opening sentence.

questions.q: Does the servant hide the possibility that the proposal may be refused?
questions.answer: No; he recounts the release from his oath and asks them to tell him if they will not agree.
key: He presents his case and asks for a decision.
A clear answer will let him know what to do next.
questions.action: Give one person the relevant facts they need to answer your request.
questions.detail: Learn from this passage how to represent the Master well.

questions.q: Why did Natan and Bath-sheba need to speak to Dawid?
questions.answer: Adonijah had assumed the kingship, and Dawid needed to hear what was happening.
key: Their report concerns a real threat to Bath-sheba and Shelomoh.
It shows why a difficult conversation may be an urgent responsibility.
questions.action: Arrange one conversation about a concrete problem you have left unaddressed.

questions.q: Am I avoiding a clear answer because I dislike disappointing someone?
questions.answer: I need to check whether my uncertainty is genuine or whether I am postponing an honest response.
key: Sometimes I need more information, and I can say so.
Leaving someone waiting without explanation may keep them from making their next decision.
questions.action: Send one honest answer or name the specific information and time you still need.

questions.q: How can I seek clarity without becoming demanding?
questions.answer: I can ask plainly and leave room for an answer I do not prefer.
key: The servant’s words include both agreement and refusal.
My request for clarity should be equally honest about those possibilities.
questions.action: Ask for a decision respectfully and agree on a reasonable time to respond.

en.actionOfDay: Before the day ends, answer one outstanding request honestly or give a clear date for your answer.

af.title: Sê Waarvoor Jy Gekom Het
af.blessing: Boker Tov! Mag vandag se Aliyah my help om eerlik te praat en die verantwoordelikheid wat aan my toevertrou is, af te handel.
af.hook: Avraham se dienaar het vir ’n duidelike antwoord gevra nadat hy verduidelik het waarom hy gekom het.
af.summary: Die dienaar loof יהוה vir sy trou en leiding. By Rivkah se huis dring hy daarop aan om sy saak te stel voordat hy eet en vertel hy van sy opdrag, gebed en ontmoeting by die put. Hy vra die familie vir ’n besliste antwoord; toe Lavan en Betuél instem, buig hy voor יהוה neer (24:27–52).

questions.q: Wat wil die dienaar doen voordat hy eet?
questions.answer: Hy wil eers verduidelik watter saak hom daarheen gebring het.
key: Hy ontvang gasvryheid sonder om sy opdrag te vergeet.
Hy sê wie se dienaar hy is en waarom hy gekom het.
questions.action: Sê in die eerste sin van een nodige gesprek waaroor jy wil praat.

questions.q: Steek die dienaar weg dat die voorstel geweier kan word?
questions.answer: Nee; hy vertel dat hy van die eed vrygestel kan word en vra hulle om te sê as hulle nie instem nie.
key: Hy stel sy saak en vra vir ’n besluit.
’n Duidelike antwoord sal hom help om te weet wat om volgende te doen.
questions.action: Gee iemand die tersaaklike feite wat nodig is om jou versoek te beantwoord.

questions.q: Waarom moes Natan en Batsheva met Dawid praat?
questions.answer: AdoniYah het die koningskap oorgeneem, en Dawid moes hoor wat aangaan.
key: Hulle verslag gaan oor ’n werklike bedreiging vir Batsheva en Shelomoh.
Dit wys waarom ’n moeilike gesprek ’n dringende verantwoordelikheid kan wees.
questions.action: Reël een gesprek oor ’n werklike probleem wat jy tot nou toe vermy het.

questions.q: Vermy ek ’n duidelike antwoord omdat ek iemand nie wil teleurstel nie?
questions.answer: Ek moet ondersoek of ek werklik onseker is en of ek ’n eerlike antwoord uitstel.
key: Soms het ek meer inligting nodig, en ek kan dit sê.
As ek iemand sonder verduideliking laat wag, kan dit hulle eie besluite ophou.
questions.action: Stuur een eerlike antwoord of sê presies watter inligting en tyd jy nog nodig het.

questions.q: Hoe kan ek duidelikheid vra sonder om veeleisend te raak?
questions.answer: Ek kan reguit vra en ruimte laat vir ’n antwoord waarvan ek nie hou nie.
key: Die dienaar maak plek vir instemming én weiering.
Ek moet net so eerlik wees wanneer ek duidelikheid vra.
questions.action: Vra respekvol vir ’n besluit en kom ooreen op ’n redelike tyd om te antwoord.

af.actionOfDay: Beantwoord voor die einde van die dag een uitstaande versoek eerlik, of gee ’n duidelike datum waarop jy sal antwoord.

en.title: Ask Her and Hear Her
en.blessing: Boker Tov! May today's Aliyah help me respect another person’s voice and take my own commitments seriously.
en.hook: Rivkah’s family had agreed, but they still called her and asked whether she would go.
en.summary: The servant gives gifts, shares a meal and asks to leave the next morning. Rivkah’s brother and mother request a delay, then call her to ask whether she will go; she agrees and departs with her attendants. She meets Yitzchak, becomes his wife, and he loves her and finds comfort after his mother’s death (24:53–67).

questions.q: Who is asked when the departure becomes a point of disagreement?
questions.answer: Rivkah herself is called and asked whether she will go with the man.
key: The family has already agreed to the match.
The account nevertheless records her own answer about going.
questions.action: Ask the person most affected by a decision what they actually want.

questions.q: What can I responsibly say about the family’s proposed delay?
questions.answer: They ask for more time, but the passage does not state their motive.
key: Missing someone, needing preparation and trying to control someone are different things.
I cannot decide which is happening here from an unstated motive.
questions.action: Separate an observable concern from what you are assuming about someone’s intentions.

questions.q: Where does this departure meet Yeshua’s words about following?
questions.answer: Both passages put a stated willingness alongside the need to set out.
key: Rivkah actually leaves, and Yeshua speaks of sustained commitment.
That connection does not make every request to hurry a command from יהוה.
questions.action: Name one commitment you have freely made and its next practical step.

questions.q: When someone I love is ready to leave, do I listen or make them carry my fear?
questions.answer: I need to express my concern without making them responsible for keeping me comfortable.
key: A departure can hurt even when I support it.
I can ask for contact and offer a blessing without using guilt.
questions.action: Express one concern directly without adding a threat or guilt-laden remark.

questions.q: What does loving a grieving spouse require of me?
questions.answer: I can offer affection and patience without expecting to replace the person they lost.
key: The verse says Yitzchak loved Rivkah and was comforted.
It does not make a new spouse responsible for removing every trace of grief.
questions.action: Ask your spouse or someone close to you what kind of support would help today.

en.actionOfDay: Within 24 hours, ask someone affected by a shared decision for their own view and listen without interrupting or correcting it.

af.title: Vra Haar en Luister
af.blessing: Boker Tov! Mag vandag se Aliyah my help om iemand anders se stem te respekteer en my eie verbintenisse ernstig op te neem.
af.hook: Rivkah se familie het ingestem, maar hulle het haar steeds geroep en gevra of sy wou gaan.
af.summary: Die dienaar gee geskenke, eet saam met die familie en vra om die volgende oggend te vertrek. Rivkah se broer en moeder vra vir uitstel en roep haar toe om te vra of sy wil gaan; sy stem in en vertrek saam met haar gevolg. Sy ontmoet Yitzchak, word sy vrou, en hy het haar lief en vind troos ná sy moeder se dood (24:53–67).

questions.q: Wie word gevra toe daar oor die vertrek verskil word?
questions.answer: Rivkah word self geroep en gevra of sy met die man wil saamgaan.
key: Die familie het reeds tot die huwelik ingestem.
Tog teken die verhaal haar eie antwoord oor die vertrek aan.
questions.action: Vra die persoon wat die meeste deur ’n besluit geraak word wat hulle self wil hê.

questions.q: Wat kan ek met sekerheid oor die familie se versoek om uitstel sê?
questions.answer: Hulle vra vir meer tyd, maar die gedeelte sê nie waarom nie.
key: Om iemand te mis, voorbereiding nodig te hê en iemand te probeer beheer, is verskillende dinge.
Ek kan nie op grond van ’n ongenoemde motief besluit wat hier gebeur nie.
questions.action: Onderskei ’n werklike besorgdheid van jou aannames oor iemand se bedoelings.

questions.q: Waar sluit hierdie vertrek by Yeshua se woorde oor navolging aan?
questions.answer: In albei gedeeltes staan uitgesproke gewilligheid langs die noodsaak om te vertrek.
key: Rivkah gaan werklik, en Yeshua praat van volgehoue toewyding.
Dit maak nie elke versoek om haastig te wees ’n opdrag van יהוה nie.
questions.action: Benoem een verbintenis wat jy vrywillig aangegaan het en die volgende praktiese stap.

questions.q: Luister ek wanneer iemand vir wie ek lief is gereed is om te gaan, of laat ek hulle my vrees dra?
questions.answer: Ek moet my besorgdheid uitspreek sonder om hulle verantwoordelik te maak om my gerus te hou.
key: ’n Afskeid kan seer wees al ondersteun ek die besluit.
Ek kan vir kontak vra en ’n seën uitspreek sonder om skuldgevoelens te gebruik.
questions.action: Spreek een bekommernis reguit uit sonder ’n dreigement of verwyt.

questions.q: Wat vra dit van my om ’n huweliksmaat wat rou lief te hê?
questions.answer: Ek kan liefde en geduld bied sonder om die persoon wat hulle verloor het te probeer vervang.
key: Die vers sê Yitzchak het Rivkah liefgehad en is getroos.
Dit maak ’n nuwe huweliksmaat nie verantwoordelik om alle hartseer te laat verdwyn nie.
questions.action: Vra jou huweliksmaat of iemand na aan jou watter ondersteuning vandag sal help.

af.actionOfDay: Vra binne 24 uur iemand wat deur ’n gesamentlike besluit geraak word vir hulle eie mening en luister sonder om hulle te onderbreek of reg te help.

en.title: Settle What You Can Today
en.blessing: Boker Tov! May today's Aliyah give me the courage to discuss the responsibilities my family will one day inherit.
en.hook: Avraham made arrangements for his sons while he was still alive.
en.summary: Avraham has further sons through Keturah. He gives his possessions to Yitzchak and gives gifts to the sons of his concubines, sending them east while he is still alive. He dies at 175; Yitzchak and Yishmael bury him beside Sarah, and Elohim blesses Yitzchak after his father’s death (25:1–11).

questions.q: When does Avraham make the arrangements described for his sons?
questions.answer: He makes them while he is still alive.
key: The text names both Yitzchak’s inheritance and gifts to the other sons.
These arrangements are made before the burial scene.
questions.action: List the family arrangements that currently depend on your unspoken intentions.

questions.q: Does this passage give every parent a rule to leave everything to one child?
questions.answer: No; it describes Avraham’s particular arrangements rather than issuing a general inheritance command.
key: I must not use this account to justify a preference I already have.
My own responsibilities require careful attention to the people affected.
questions.action: Write down who would be affected by an arrangement you are considering.

questions.q: What does Dawid’s situation add to this reading?
questions.answer: It shows the danger of an unsettled succession and Dawid’s decision to act on his oath that day.
key: Bath-sheba names a threat to herself and Shelomoh.
A private intention had not prevented a public crisis.
questions.action: Tell the appropriate person where your important instructions are kept.

questions.q: What am I avoiding because I dislike talking about death?
questions.answer: I need to identify what my silence would leave someone else to sort out.
key: This may include dependants, debts, documents or care arrangements.
I do not have to solve everything today to begin an honest conversation.
questions.action: Choose one unfinished responsibility and name the person who needs to discuss it with you.

questions.q: What can I say about Yitzchak and Yishmael burying their father together?
questions.answer: They both take part in the burial, but the passage does not describe a complete reconciliation.
key: I can honour that shared act without inventing the brothers’ feelings.
In my own family, one limited act of cooperation may be possible even when other matters remain unresolved.
questions.action: Propose one practical shared task if contact is safe and appropriate.

en.actionOfDay: Within 24 hours, list three unfinished family responsibilities and arrange one conversation to begin addressing the first.

af.title: Reël Vandag Wat Jy Kan
af.blessing: Boker Tov! Mag vandag se Aliyah my moed gee om te praat oor die verantwoordelikhede wat my familie eendag sal oorneem.
af.hook: Avraham het reëlings vir sy seuns getref terwyl hy nog geleef het.
af.summary: Avraham het nog seuns by Ketura. Hy gee sy besittings aan Yitzchak en gee geskenke aan die seuns van sy byvroue; hy laat hulle ooswaarts wegtrek terwyl hy nog leef. Hy sterf op 175; Yitzchak en Yishmael begrawe hom langs Sarah, en Elohim seën Yitzchak ná sy vader se dood (25:1–11).

questions.q: Wanneer tref Avraham die genoemde reëlings vir sy seuns?
questions.answer: Hy tref dit terwyl hy nog leef.
key: Die teks noem Yitzchak se erfenis én geskenke aan die ander seuns.
Hierdie reëlings word voor die begrafnistoneel getref.
questions.action: Maak ’n lys van die familiereëlings wat tans net op jou onuitgesproke voornemens berus.

questions.q: Gee hierdie gedeelte elke ouer ’n reël om alles aan een kind na te laat?
questions.answer: Nee; dit beskryf Avraham se bepaalde reëlings en gee nie ’n algemene erfbevel nie.
key: Ek moet nie hierdie verhaal gebruik om ’n bestaande voorkeur te regverdig nie.
My eie verantwoordelikhede vra dat ek die mense wat geraak word deeglik in ag neem.
questions.action: Skryf neer wie deur ’n reëling wat jy oorweeg geraak sal word.

questions.q: Wat voeg Dawid se situasie by hierdie lesing?
questions.answer: Dit wys die gevaar van ’n onbesliste opvolging en Dawid se besluit om sy eed daardie dag uit te voer.
key: Batsheva noem die bedreiging vir haarself en Shelomoh.
’n Voorneme wat nie behoorlik uitgevoer is nie, het nie ’n openbare krisis gekeer nie.
questions.action: Vertel die regte persoon waar jou belangrike instruksies gebêre word.

questions.q: Wat vermy ek omdat ek nie oor die dood wil praat nie?
questions.answer: Ek moet vasstel wat my stilte iemand anders sal laat uitsorteer.
key: Dit kan afhanklikes, skuld, dokumente of versorgingsreëlings insluit.
Ek hoef nie vandag alles op te los om ’n eerlike gesprek te begin nie.
questions.action: Kies een onafgehandelde verantwoordelikheid en benoem die persoon met wie jy daaroor moet praat.

questions.q: Wat kan ek sê oor Yitzchak en Yishmael wat hulle vader saam begrawe?
questions.answer: Hulle neem albei aan die begrafnis deel, maar die gedeelte beskryf nie ’n volledige versoening nie.
key: Ek kan daardie gesamentlike daad erken sonder om die broers se gevoelens uit te dink.
In my eie familie kan een beperkte daad van samewerking moontlik wees al bly ander sake onopgelos.
questions.action: Stel een praktiese taak voor wat julle kan deel indien kontak veilig en gepas is.

af.actionOfDay: Maak binne 24 uur ’n lys van drie onafgehandelde familieverantwoordelikhede en reël een gesprek om die eerste te begin aanpak.

en.title: Do I Only Remember the Conflict?
en.blessing: Shabbat Shalom! May today's Aliyah help me speak about other families with the care I want shown to my own.
en.hook: The Torah records Yishmael’s sons by name and gives an account of his life and death.
en.summary: The genealogy identifies Yishmael as Avraham’s son, born to Hagar. It names his twelve sons and describes twelve princes according to their clans and settlements. Yishmael dies at 137, and the account records where his descendants live (25:12–18).

questions.q: What does the Torah record about Yishmael’s family?
questions.answer: It gives the names of his twelve sons and identifies their clans and settlements.
key: These people receive a place in the account.
I should pay attention to what is recorded before reducing them to a label.
questions.action: Read the twelve names aloud without skipping the genealogy.

questions.q: Does Yitzchak’s place in the preceding account make Yishmael’s life disappear?
questions.answer: No; the Torah follows the blessing of Yitzchak with Yishmael’s genealogy.
key: The two accounts have distinct content.
Paying attention to one does not require me to erase the other.
questions.action: Describe someone outside your own circle without beginning with your disagreement.

questions.q: How does this genealogy connect to יהוה’s earlier words about Yishmael?
questions.answer: The twelve princes correspond to the earlier promise that Yishmael would father twelve princes.
key: This is a specific textual connection.
I do not need to assign these names to present-day nations to recognise it.
questions.action: Read Bereishit 17:20 beside 25:16 and identify the shared detail.

questions.q: Have I made someone’s family history the whole explanation of who they are?
questions.answer: I need to ask what I actually know about the person in front of me.
key: A surname, nationality or painful family association can shape my assumptions.
It cannot tell me everything about an individual’s conduct.
questions.action: Replace one generalisation with a question you can ask respectfully.

questions.q: How should this affect the way I speak this Shabbat?
questions.answer: I can speak accurately about a person and refuse insults about their whole family or people.
key: Specific wrongdoing can be named without extending blame to everyone related to the offender.
Careful speech still leaves room for necessary boundaries.
questions.action: Correct one sweeping statement before you repeat or forward it.

en.actionOfDay: Before sharing a claim about a family or people, identify its evidence and remove any blame that goes beyond the specific conduct described.

af.title: Onthou Ek Net die Konflik?
af.blessing: Shabbat Shalom! Mag vandag se Aliyah my help om oor ander families te praat met die sorg wat ek vir my eie familie verlang.
af.hook: Die Torah noem Yishmael se seuns by die naam en vertel van sy lewe en dood.
af.summary: Die geslagsregister identifiseer Yishmael as Avraham se seun wat uit Hagar gebore is. Dit noem sy twaalf seuns en beskryf twaalf heersers volgens hulle stamme en woonplekke. Yishmael sterf op 137, en die verhaal teken aan waar sy nageslag woon (25:12–18).

questions.q: Wat teken die Torah oor Yishmael se familie aan?
questions.answer: Dit gee die name van sy twaalf seuns en noem hulle stamme en woonplekke.
key: Hierdie mense kry plek in die verhaal.
Ek behoort op te let wat geskryf staan voordat ek hulle tot ’n etiket reduseer.
questions.action: Lees die twaalf name hardop sonder om die geslagsregister oor te slaan.

questions.q: Laat Yitzchak se plek in die voorafgaande verhaal Yishmael se lewe verdwyn?
questions.answer: Nee; ná die seën van Yitzchak volg Yishmael se geslagsregister.
key: Die twee verhale het elkeen hulle eie inhoud.
Om die een ernstig op te neem, vereis nie dat ek die ander uitwis nie.
questions.action: Beskryf iemand buite jou eie kring sonder om met julle verskil te begin.

questions.q: Hoe sluit hierdie geslagsregister by יהוה se vroeëre woorde oor Yishmael aan?
questions.answer: Die twaalf heersers stem ooreen met die vroeëre belofte dat Yishmael twaalf heersers sou verwek.
key: Dit is ’n bepaalde teksverband.
Ek hoef nie hierdie name aan hedendaagse volke toe te skryf om dit raak te sien nie.
questions.action: Lees Bereishit 17:20 saam met 25:16 en wys die ooreenstemmende besonderheid uit.

questions.q: Het ek iemand se familiegeskiedenis die hele verklaring gemaak van wie hulle is?
questions.answer: Ek moet vra wat ek werklik weet van die persoon voor my.
key: ’n Van, nasionaliteit of pynlike familieverband kan my aannames beïnvloed.
Dit vertel my nie alles van ’n individu se optrede nie.
questions.action: Vervang een veralgemening met ’n vraag wat jy respekvol kan vra.

questions.q: Hoe behoort dit my woorde hierdie Shabbat te beïnvloed?
questions.answer: Ek kan akkuraat oor iemand praat en weier om hulle hele familie of volk te beledig.
key: Bepaalde verkeerde dade kan benoem word sonder om almal wat aan die oortreder verwant is te blameer.
Noukeurige woorde laat steeds plek vir nodige grense.
questions.action: Stel een veralgemening reg voordat jy dit herhaal of aanstuur.

af.actionOfDay: Voordat jy ’n bewering oor ’n familie of volk deel, bepaal waarop dit berus en verwyder enige blaam wat verder as die genoemde optrede strek.
